seoTitle: FV Funding | Business Funding Advisory for MSMEs in Gujarat
seoDescription: CA-led business funding advisory. Working capital, term loans, CAPEX, project and machinery finance, and government scheme support for MSMEs, manufacturers and traders.

hero.subtitle: CA-led business funding advisory for MSMEs, manufacturers, traders and growing companies.
hero.serviceLine: Working capital · Term loans · CAPEX · Project finance · Machinery finance

problem.title: Good businesses get rejected for avoidable reasons.

items.title: Wrong lender.
items.text: Every bank and NBFC has its own appetite. A good file sent to the wrong desk still comes back.

items.title: Wrong product.
items.text: A term loan asked for when the need is working capital, or the reverse, strains cash flow from day one.

items.title: Numbers told the wrong way.
items.text: Presented the way an accountant files them, not the way a credit officer reads them.

problem.closing: Lenders sanction loans. We make sure your file deserves a yes.

services.title: Nine ways to fund a growing business.
services.schemeNote: Scheme benefits are decided and paid by the government agency concerned, usually after the loan is disbursed and conditions are met. We check eligibility and handle the filing; we do not guarantee approval.

process.title: One advisor. Six steps. No guesswork.

steps.title: Discovery call
steps.text: Your requirement, timeline and existing borrowings.

steps.title: Financial diagnosis
steps.text: Financials, GST returns, bank statements and credit reports, read through a lender's eyes.

steps.title: Funding structure
steps.text: The right product, amount, tenure and security for your cash flows.

steps.title: Lender-ready file
steps.text: CMA data, project report and a complete document set.

steps.title: Lender matching and application
steps.text: We approach suitable banks and NBFCs and handle their queries.

steps.title: Sanction to disbursement
steps.text: Term-sheet review, follow-up to disbursement, and annual renewal support.

check.title: What do you need funding for?
check.text: Pick the closest one. The Funding Readiness Check takes about two minutes.

why.title: Advice first. Then the lender.

pillars.title: CA-led, not sales-led.
pillars.text: Your file is built by a qualified Chartered Accountant, not a loan agent chasing a target.

pillars.title: Business funding only.
pillars.text: No home loans, car loans or credit cards. Just facilities that run and grow businesses.

pillars.title: The right facility first.
pillars.text: We recommend what fits your cash flows, then find the lender, not the reverse.

pillars.title: Fees in writing, before we start.
pillars.text: Agreed and signed before any work begins.

pillars.title: One point of contact.
pillars.text: From the first call to disbursement and renewal.

do: Diagnose your financials the way a lender will
Structure the right type and size of facility
Approach banks and NBFCs whose criteria you fit
Follow up to disbursement and renewal
dont: Lend money: lenders decide every sanction
Handle home, car or personal loans
Charge anything not agreed in writing

who.title: Businesses that make, trade and serve.
segments: Growing companies and funded startups with revenue

bring.title: Bring these, and the first call goes twice as far.
bring.text: You don't need everything to book. Whatever you have helps us give a sharper first view.
items: Last 3 years' financial statements and ITRs
Last 12 months' bank statements (all current accounts)
GST returns for the last 12 months
Sanction letters and repayment schedules of existing loans
KYC of the business and promoters

insights.title: Notes from the credit side of the table.

closing.title: Start with a free 30-minute
closing.text: Choose what it's about. Pick a time on the next screen.
